summary: Turkcell filed a Form 6-K press release announcing that Chief Sales Officer Kadri Özdal resigned effective September 8, 2026; Metin Tutaş, formerly General Manager of Turkcell Global Bilgi, was appointed as new Chief Sales Officer effective September 9, 2026. This is a routine executive succession with no special-situation transaction or activist context. No deal terms, board advisory, or structural mechanics apply. The change is operational, not a forced departure, but as an abrupt C-suite resignation and replacement disclosed via Form 6-K, it qualifies as a management-change event. Watch for any strategic implications from sales leadership transition.
